title: Эвакуатор
purpose: Public towing arrangement for the Chattanooga shops; Nashville is deliberately thin.
differs_from_en: Partner V8 «Автоспас 73» serves the two Ulyanovsk shops and is not named to customers; the price is by kilometre.
Kazan: no partner and no price anywhere in the base (planted gap kept).
new_facts: Tow price: 3 000 RUB with the first 10 km, 70 RUB for each further km. The ERP needs matching sublet lines for towed cars.
